content: jekyll-scholar latest version 7.3.0 (Jan 6, 2026) requires Ruby >= 3.0. Known compatibility issues exist between jekyll-scholar 7.1.3, Jekyll 4.3.3, and Ruby 3.3.0 causing Liquid exceptions. Solutions include downgrading Ruby to 2.7.2, updating jekyll-scholar and dependencies (especially bibtex-ruby), or using compatible version combinations. jekyll-scholar requires BibTeX-Ruby ~> 4.0 and citeproc-ruby ~ 1.1.
